title: Commercial Arithmetic: Profit, Interest, Discount, Commission and VAT
seo_title: Commercial Arithmetic – Primary 6 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Solve problems on profit and loss per cent, simple interest, discount, commission, VAT and hire purchase using naira. (summary of the NERDC Primary 6 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free Primary 6 maths worksheets on commercial arithmetic in naira: profit and loss per cent, simple interest, discount, commission, VAT at 7.5% and hire purchase. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Profit or loss per cent is always worked on the cost price.
  • Simple interest I = PRT ÷ 100. Amount = principal + interest.
  • VAT in Nigeria is 7.5% of the price. In hire purchase you pay a deposit and then instalments, so you pay more than the cash price.

Examples

Example

Bought ₦40,000, sold ₦46,000

Profit ₦6,000

6,000 ÷ 40,000 × 100

Answer: 15% profit

Example

VAT on ₦20,000

20,000 × 7.5 ÷ 100

Answer: ₦1,500

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Using the selling price for profit per centDivide by the cost price.
Forgetting to add the depositHire purchase total = deposit + all instalments.
Taking the rate per month for per yearPer annum means per year.
